mapper.select: SELECT mood_tag_id AS moodTagId, tag_name AS tagName FROM mood_tags ORDER BY moodTagId

SELECT song_id AS songId, track_id AS trackId, track_name AS trackName, artist_name AS artistName, artwork_url AS artworkUrl, preview_url AS previewUrl, apple_music_url AS appleMusicUrl FROM songs WHERE song_id = #{songId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (post_id, user_id, song_id, mood_tag_id, posted_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, 1, #{moodTagId}, now());
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.user_id AS userId, p.song_id AS songId, p.mood_tag_id AS moodTagId, p.posted_at AS postedAt, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, u.user_icon AS userIcon, s.track_id AS trackId, s.track_name AS trackName, s.artwork_url AS artworkUrl, s.preview_url AS previewUrl, s.apple_music_url AS appleMusicUrl, m.tag_name AS tagName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN songs s ON p.song_id = s.song_id JOIN mood_tags m ON p.mood_tag_id = m.mood_tag_id JOIN friends f ON u.user_id = f.friend_id WHERE f.friend_status = 1 ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC
